summary: Computes a tire suspension force from compound properties, a mode selector and a session state value. Looks up the session state value (used as denominator) via SessionStateIndexedLookup, then returns 0 when tire brand data (unk_8ADB88) is unavailable or the compound data pointer cannot be resolved from the compound index at this+0xBC4. Selects a base force coefficient from the compound data according to the mode selector global dword_8AEEC0 (0 = aero field at +384 scaled by 0.98, 1 = blend of the +384 and +56 fields, 2 = suspension field at +56), returns 0 for any other selector value, scales the coefficient again by 0.98, and returns the scaled coefficient times the per-state suspension terms (int at this+0x1584 times double at this+0x1578 plus double at this+0x1570) divided by the session value, only while the scaled coefficient is positive.

local_names.this: tire/suspension state object providing the compound index and per-state force terms
local_names.compound: compound data structure resolved by CompoundIndexLookup from this+0xBC4
local_names.coeff: base force coefficient selected from compound fields by the mode selector

Returns the computed force when the scaled coefficient is positive, otherwise 0
